name: list_vercel_ci_invocations
description:
List Vercel CI invocations for a team. Optionally filter by repository provider, repository, branch, commit snapshot, author, status, conclusion, source, or creation time. Paginated with limit (default 20, max 100) and cursor.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v2/vercel-ci/invocations --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Number of results per page (default: 20, max: 100).

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
